shared/scripts/verify/chunk-budget.mjs

Minified chunk-size gate. Scans dist/v/<tier>/assets/{js,css}
Sourcesrc/shared/scripts/verify/chunk-budget.mjs
UX surfaceThe repo verbs — build, verify, test, docs, i18n, media, setup, scaffold.

Members

BUDGETS

Hard caps on emitted file size (bytes).

EXEMPT_TIERS

Tiers exempt from the gate — every legacy tier is intentionally monolithic because ES5-era engines cannot load module chunks.

nameKey

Exception patterns are regex strings matched against the emitted file's name-without-hash (e.g. three.webgpu matches three.webgpu-CkO-_Y2V.js across every tier).

collectFiles

Recursively collects emitted .js/.css files under a tier's assets dir.
